item.question: What advantages does multimodal joint training offer in video-to-audio synthesis?
item.answer: Multimodal joint training allows MMAudio to leverage larger-scale text-audio data, enabling it to generate semantically aligned high-quality audio samples. This approach improves performance in terms of audio quality, semantic alignment, and synchronization compared to single-modality training.
